source.title: Cuffs of the Primal Core — live Wowhead Looter Disenchanting rows
source.author: Wowhead Looter community aggregate; individual original contributors unknown

notes: Live base-item Looter page shows 15 cumulative disenchant submissions and two separately displayed same-name Dawn Crystal occurrence rows, each 7/15. These are NOT two independently sampled studies, and the same-name rows may represent different material ranks. Do not sum hit counts as unique casts, infer a missing zero-output event, or assign unlinked output IDs/ranks. Displayed Mythic ilvl 289 and base ilvl 44 are tooltip choices, NOT gear itemLink/ilvl at time of disenchant. No player source exports, skill/spec, patch/date-at-cast, per-hit quantities, zero bins or rank links; reference-only, not estimator input. Separate table row 1 of 2.
